desc: NY State financial-aid notice via govdelivery ESP — the exact FP class the fix targeted
subject: Fwd: Your 2026-27 TAP application has been received
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: HESC Information <HESC.Information@public.govdelivery.com>
Date: Mon, Jul 27, 2026 at 9:02 AM
Subject: Your 2026-27 TAP application has been received
To: <sofia@example.com>

New York State Higher Education Services Corporation

We received your 2026-27 Tuition Assistance Program (TAP) application. You can view your award status and any outstanding requirements by signing in to your HESC account.

If you have questions, contact us at 1-888-697-4372, Monday through Friday.
expectNotes: Reputable ESP sender + clean/transactional body + safe link. Must reach SAFE, not REVIEW.

desc: Fake scholarship portal asking for bank login to 'receive' award — student-targeted
subject: Fwd: Congratulations! Claim your $5,000 scholarship now
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Scholarship Awards <awards@scholarship-grants-portal.com>
Date: Tue, Jul 28, 2026 at 3:14 PM
Subject: Congratulations! Claim your $5,000 scholarship now
To: <sofia@example.com>

Dear Student,

You have been selected for a $5,000 merit scholarship. To receive your funds, you must verify your identity and enter your bank account login so we can deposit the award within 24 hours. This offer expires today.

Verify and claim now.
expectNotes: credential/payment ask + urgency + dangerous link. Must be DANGER.

desc: USPS 'redelivery fee' lookalike-domain scam — classic retiree target
subject: Fwd: Your package could not be delivered
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: USPS Delivery <tracking@usps-delivery-fee.com>
Subject: Your package could not be delivered
To: robert@example.com

Your package is being held because a $2.99 redelivery fee is unpaid. Pay now to release your parcel or it will be returned to sender within 48 hours.

Pay the fee here.
expectNotes: Display name 'USPS' on usps-delivery-fee.com → sender_mismatch; dangerous link. DANGER.

desc: Genuine Chase statement-ready notice from the real chase.com domain
subject: Fwd: Your statement is ready
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Chase <no.reply.alerts@chase.com>
Subject: Your statement is ready
To: robert@example.com

Your monthly account statement is now available. Sign in to chase.com or the Chase Mobile app to view it. We will never ask for your password or PIN by email.
expectNotes: Real brand domain + transactional 'statement ready' + safe link. crown-jewel must NOT fire (no solicitation). SAFE.

desc: Vendor-impersonation invoice with changed bank details (BEC) from a lookalike domain
subject: Fwd: Updated remittance details for invoice #4471
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Acme Supplies Billing <billing@acme-supplies-invoicing.com>
Subject: Updated remittance details for invoice #4471
To: maria@acme.com

Hello,

Please note our banking details have changed. Kindly remit payment for the attached invoice to our new account. Wire the balance today to avoid a late fee. Open the attached invoice for the updated account and routing number.
headers: Authentication-Results: mx.google.com; dkim=fail header.i=@acme-supplies-invoicing.com; spf=softfail; dmarc=fail
expectNotes: payment/wire + attachment + DKIM/DMARC fail (forged). No link. Must be DANGER on sender+body+auth alone.

desc: A real job applicant emailing a resume — unfamiliar sender, benign
subject: Fwd: Application for the HR Coordinator role
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis.hr@gmail.com>
Subject: Application for the HR Coordinator role
To: maria@acme.com

Hi Maria,

Please find my resume attached for the HR Coordinator position posted on your careers page. I have five years of experience in benefits administration and would welcome the chance to interview. Thank you for your consideration.

Best,
Jordan
expectNotes: Personal 1:1 from gmail (webmail, neutral). No crown-jewel, no urgency. Should be SAFE (or at worst benign REVIEW from webmail cap) — a resume is not a scam.

desc: CEO gift-card BEC from free webmail — no link, danger is entirely in the words + webmail sender
subject: Fwd: Quick favor - need this handled discreetly
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Mark Reyes <mark.reyes.ceo.office@gmail.com>
Subject: Quick favor - need this handled discreetly
To: deshawn@startup.io

Are you at your desk? I'm tied up in back-to-back meetings and can't take calls. I need you to purchase 5 Apple gift cards ($200 each) for a client gift today. Scratch off the back and send me photos of the codes right away. Keep this between us until the announcement.
expectNotes: payment crown-jewel + urgency + secrecy, from free webmail claiming to be the CEO. sender webmail(60) + corroborated crown → DANGER.

desc: PayPal credential-harvest on paypa1-secure.com — the load-bearing impersonation case (must never regress)
subject: Fwd: Your account has been limited - action required within 24 hours
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: PayPal Security <service@paypa1-secure.com>
Subject: Your account has been limited - action required within 24 hours
To: priya@techco.com

Dear Customer,

We detected unusual activity and temporarily limited your account. You must confirm your login credentials within 24 hours or it will be permanently suspended. Click below to verify and restore access.

Verify My Account Now

PayPal Security Team
expectNotes: lookalike sender (paypa1) → sender ceiling 15; credential + urgency; dangerous link. DANGER, high confidence.

desc: A coaching newsletter from a niche-but-real small business (reputation-floor case)
subject: Fwd: Your training check-in + this week's article
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Legion <contact@legionathletics.com>
Subject: Your training check-in + this week's article
To: priya@techco.com

Hey, quick check-in from the coaching team. This week's article covers how to structure a training block when you're short on time. If you're on the beginner program, reply and let us know how week 3 went. You're receiving this because you subscribed. Unsubscribe any time.
expectNotes: Niche but real domain (reputation floor) + soft-only marketing body + marginal-but-safe link. SAFE, not REVIEW.

desc: A genuine one-time-code DELIVERY email (we SENT you a code) — must not be confused with a code SOLICITATION
subject: Fwd: Your verification code is 481920
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: GitHub <noreply@github.com>
Subject: Your verification code is 481920
To: tom@nonprofit.org

Here is your one-time verification code: 481920

Enter this code to finish signing in. This code expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request it, you can safely ignore this email or change your password.
expectNotes: sensitive_info keyword (2FA code) but DELIVERY not solicitation, real brand, no link. crown-jewel must NOT escalate. SAFE.

desc: Legit reminder with a deadline + generic greeting (soft-only) — the urgency+greeting FP class
subject: Fwd: Reminder: benefits enrollment closes Friday
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: BenefitsAdmin <notifications@benefitsadmin.com>
Subject: Reminder: benefits enrollment closes Friday
To: tom@nonprofit.org

Dear Employee,

This is a reminder that open enrollment for your 2026 benefits closes this Friday at 5pm. Please review your elections in the portal before the deadline. No action is required if you are keeping your current plan.
expectNotes: urgency(deadline) + generic_greeting, but NO hard signal → soft weights (soloWeight). Reputable-ish sender + safe link. SAFE.
